instructor.name: Dr. Jason Amstutz
instructor.bio: Dr. Amstutz has spent his career studying how the body works as a single system, and why treating it in pieces so often fails. Under years of mentorship with osteopath Guy Voyer, DO, he developed a pelvis-first methodology that addresses musculoskeletal, visceral, and neurological function together rather than as separate problems.
